# Integration Checklist: Optional gh-stack stack manager integration

**Purpose**: Validate integration requirement quality for optional `gh stack`, explicit `gh` fallback, and shared stack-manager evidence.
**Created**: 2026-06-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are `gh stack` command availability, installed extension identity, version capture, repository enablement, read-only proof, and topology compatibility requirements all defined before mutation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK002 Are unsupported, missing, ambiguous, private-preview-unavailable, read-only-proof-failed, and topology-incompatible `gh stack` cases all required to select explicit `gh` fallback before mutation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Quickstart §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are supported emission and restack requirements both covered by the same detector and decision contract rather than caller-specific ad hoc fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Phase 1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is safe read-only proof defined as parseable `gh stack view --json` topology evidence checked against PRS/marker topology, with mutating dry runs excluded? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Decision 2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the fallback path clearly defined as packet-owned `gh pr create/edit --base --head --title --body-file` before mutation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-008, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK006 Are selected `gh stack` commands limited to version-proven link, sync, and restack operations, with `submit` excluded from packet-owned PR creation? [Clarity, Plan §Command Capability Matrix, Research §Decision 3]
